description.en: A complete high-backed sauropod reconstruction with an elevated mid-dorsal profile. The skeleton is very incomplete: much of the head, neck, limbs and tail is inferred, and the exact external soft-tissue ridge is unknown.
description.zh: 完整高背蜥脚类复原，呈现明显抬高的背中部轮廓。骨架很不完整，头颈、四肢和尾的许多部分为推定，体表软组织脊的确切形态未知。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete high-backed sauropod with distinctly elevated mid-dorsal profile, full neck/head, four limbs and long tail. Original whole-organism target, not isolated vertebra.

scientific_limits.en: Highly incomplete skeleton: genuine tall dorsal neural spines and scapula inform trunk, but head, much of neck, limbs and tail require reconstruction. Whole silhouette is artistic, not evidence of a complete preserved individual.20m is NHM genus estimate, not measured fossil length. Tall bony support is established, but external sail or fleshy ridge structure and function are not preserved. Neutral modest tissue-covered high back chosen without claiming exact soft tissue.
scientific_limits.zh: 骨架很不完整：真实高背椎神经棘与肩胛支持躯干，头、颈及肢尾多处需推定。完整外轮廓是美术复原，不是保存完整个体的证据。20米为NHM属级估值，非化石实测。高骨性支撑有证据，外部帆或肉质脊形态和功能并未保存，采用中性覆肉高背而不宣称确切软组织。

scale.basis: NHM Dino Directory genus estimate. Not measured holotype full length.

diagnostic_targets: Clearly tall mid-back profile rising above shoulder and pelvis, supported by exceptionally elongated dorsal neural spines.
High profile integrated with trunk as tissue-covered ridge, not separate giant exposed bone needles.
Relatively modest neck and small reconstructed head, robust quadruped and long tapering tail.
No duplicated Amargasaurus neck spike rows, no Stegosaurus plates, no invented tail club.
Head shape conservatively reconstructed; specialized Nigersaurus broad muzzle is not demonstrated for this taxon.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed Ibrahimetal2020 Fig104 holotype dorsal vertebra in two views and scapula; Wilson/Allain2015 describes partial holotype. Additional known-material silhouette only illustrates extensive missing regions, not primary anatomical evidence.

reference_credits.title: Ibrahim etal2020, Geology and paleontology of the Upper Cretaceous Kem Kem Group, Fig104
Wilson and Allain2015 Osteology of Rebbachisaurus garasbae
